editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: BlackBull Markets is an FMA New Zealand-regulated broker scoring 7.2/10 from NAFT in 2026. ECN Prime at 0.0 pips + $6 RT is among the cheapest. Full platform suite (cTrader, MT4, MT5, TradingView) and 26,000+ instruments. Built-in copy trading. Limited by mid-tier NZ regulation and no investor compensation scheme. Best for cost-focused traders who prioritise execution quality over regulatory prestige.
